question: A man travelled from A to B at a speed of 10 m/sec, and returned to A from B at a speed of x km/h. If his average speed is 45 km/h, then what is the value of x ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert the forward speed from m/s to km/h: S₁ = 10 × (18 / 5) = 36 km/h.

For equal travel distances, the average speed formula is: (2 × S₁ × S₂) / (S₁ + S₂).

⇒ 45 = (2 × 36 × x) / (36 + x)

⇒ 45 × (36 + x) = 72x

⇒ 1620 + 45x = 72x ⇒ 27x = 1620 ⇒ x = 60

**∴ The correct answer is x = 60.**
